description.name: CoinsPay
description.tagline: Let clients pay invoices in USDT, BTC, ETH and 30+ other coins and tokens.
description.long: The client presses Pay Now, picks a coin and a network on the CoinsPay payment page and pays. The payment is added to the invoice automatically, and CoinsPay sends the money on to your own wallets in the shares you set.
features: Clients pay on the CoinsPay payment page in USDT, BTC, ETH and 30+ other coins and tokens
The payment is added to the invoice automatically, exactly once
Payouts go straight to your own wallets in the shares you set
Signed webhooks, with the WHMCS cron as a fallback
Changed, cancelled or otherwise paid invoices cancel the CoinsPay invoice
Test mode: invoices paid without money, visible to admins only
